scripts.prebuild: npm audit --json > /tmp/npm-audit-report.json || true; node -e "const r=require('/tmp/npm-audit-report.json'); console.log('AUDIT_SUMMARY', JSON.stringify(r.metadata?.vulnerabilities || {})); for (const [name,v] of Object.entries(r.vulnerabilities || {})) console.log('AUDIT_VULN', JSON.stringify({name,severity:v.severity,isDirect:v.isDirect,range:v.range,via:v.via,fixAvailable:v.fixAvailable,nodes:v.nodes}));"
